title: 🔥 400 Reps Upper Body Posture Challenge – Daily!🔥 #homeworkout #shorts #yoga
description:
4 bodyweight exercises – every day – 100 reps each = 400 total 🏋️‍♀️  
Perfect for strengthening your back & shoulders, opening the chest and improving posture 💫  

💥 You can optionally wear weighted wrist cuffs, like I do, to slightly increase the intensity.  
👉 But it’s absolutely effective and doable daily without any weights ✔️  

✅ Build strength & better posture  
✅ Simple, everyday-friendly routine  
✅ Stay motivated together
